title: SEO and AEO: A Practical Growth Framework
author: Benvor Digital
excerpt: A practical framework for building content that earns visibility across search engines and answer-driven discovery.
body:
Start with search intent, technical quality, and useful content. Then structure important pages so the answer is clear, evidence is easy to understand, and the next action is obvious.

AEO does not replace SEO. It extends the same fundamentals into environments where customers increasingly expect direct, useful answers.
